english: ...How is it, sniper?\nHow's [MERU] doing?
...How is it, sniper?\nHow's [NOEL] doing?
Target confirmed. No movement.
You can see that well from this distance\nwith no scope...?
Target confirmed here too. No movement.
Any other intel?
No signs of activity from the target.\nNo energy detected.\nNo sign she's noticed us.
So at this distance, we're safe?
To run right away if something happens,\nwe need to stay near Polyal.
This is surveillance only - watch,\nno fighting planned.
But why is she\njust standing still...?\nCould she be tired...?
I wonder if she eats?
You're always worried about food, Koto.\nBut word is her energy is\nlimitless, so she probably doesn't eat.
Not even able to eat... poor thing.
Yeah!\n[MERU] must be\nso hungry.
Yeah!\n[NOEL] must be\nso hungry.
In the first place, in that state,\nis she even conscious, I wonder?
If she is, it's painful; if she isn't, it's painful...
When Eve fell,\nshe seemed lost to rage.
I understand.\nMy power went wild once too, and I lost myself,\nrampaged... and I was so sad then.
I think that's proof you're still sane.\nIf you're really broken, you don't feel sadness\nno matter how much violence you dish out.
I still haven't given up on saving her.
Of course, I won't give up either.\nBig or small, I owe my life\nto Hibiki, her, and everyone.
But Hibiki, that doesn't mean\nyou can put our comrades in danger.\nUnderstood?
Of course!
As long as she's in observation range, the IS can\nrecord the Goddess of Destruction's state.\nHopefully that turns up a countermeasure.
Even with the IS, we can't\njust approach her.
Now it's about what Mie and Kei do.
Come to think of it, Mie and Kei\ngot beat but didn't disappear, right?
That's just how strong those two are.
They're THAT strong?
Yeah, no doubt.
Will they appear again?
If Mie or Kei shows up,\nwe'll have to fight.
Wouldn't running be better?
I heard she awakens when\nshe learns the truth of the world, but...
Hasn't she already awakened, nyu?
Maybe her current state isn't\na complete awakening.
Aoi, what do you mean?
The fact that she's stopped moving like this -\ncould it be because the awakening is incomplete...?
I see - that's probably related to how\nshe took that form without meeting\nthe 'learn the truth of the world' condition.
Hibiki, what do you think?
She might really be incomplete.
When truly outrageous power awakens,\nyou can't just stand still quietly like that.\nYou'd definitely go on a rampage.
Maybe... she'd be overwhelmed\nby the overflowing power.
Just standing still like that,\nshe couldn't possibly destroy all the worlds -\nit's more natural to think she's still incomplete!
I agree.
Even so, what do we do?
We can't go poking her right now...
Something's coming!
Right on cue, huh!\nWho the hell is it?
One person on foot, it seems!\nThis movement pattern is...!
Found it! A new toooy!\nAhaha! Let's plaaay!!
What are you here for!
I came to play, obviouslyyy!\nC'mon, look, look!
Don't do anything stupid! Go home!
YOU go home.\nIsn't it dangerous for youu?
You're the one in danger!\nI'll stop you no matter what!
Ahaha! Funny joke!\nEveryone's weaker than Mii -\ncan you really stop mee?
No matter how strong you are,\nthere are ways to deal with you!
Hmm, you really don't want Mii\ngetting close to that black monster?
She's not a monster!\nThat's [MERU]!
She's not a monster!\nThat's [NOEL]!
Is that really truee?\nI've gotta get close and test\nall sorts of things to check! Ahaha!
Ngh! How nasty...!
No one can stop Mii!\nGo go go! Charge, charge!
Wah! The population density!?
They're not people, so it's not population density, but...\nthis is no time for that.\nWe need to thin their numbers!
Strike first, strike hard - take them all down!
Hee, not bad.
Heave-ho!
Huh!?
Fancy trick, huh...!
Ehem! That was nothing.\nI'm a king, after all! Ahaha!!
You're bored, right?\nHeheh, wanna play with your uncle here?
Officer! This is the guy!
Know the game cops-and-robbers?\nIt's pretty fun, y'know?
Mii wins at every normal game.\nBut if you throw in that black monster too, deal!
That's out of the question!
Even like that,\nI still believe she can be saved!\nPlease, don't get in the way!
Nooope.
Why!?\nAt this rate the whole world is in danger!
Mii's not in danger.\nNeither's Kei-chan.
A king who only thinks of himself\nis a naked king!
Ahaha! Good one!\nOne zabuton for you!\nMii doesn't mind being naked, though. Mii doesn't!
Stop! Don't come any closer!
Even if you say stoooopp♪\nI just can't help it! Tehepero!
(Twitch.)
(Wh-what is this...\nabnormally irritating feeling...!)
Playing with you guys is low on thrills.\nMii likes THIS better!
Oh no!!
Energy reaction detected!\nIt's moving!
That bastard!! She did it!
Everyone, prepare to retreat!! Don't get close!
Gooood morning!\nA wake-up call!! Ya-hoo!
Mikyuu...
Damn... goofy bastard, but\nshe took down THAT Mie in one hit...!
Impossible! This is hopeless!
Nighty-night...
Stirring up trouble and running off!\nShe never does anything decent!
Ah, she's looking this way...!
Bad!
What do we do!?
I'll draw a defense line with the IS!\nEveryone else fall back!\nGet as many as you can to Polyal!
I'm staying too!
You saw that, right? There's no reasoning with her.
I know!\nBut I don't want [MERU]\nto kill anyone!
I know!\nBut I don't want [NOEL]\nto kill anyone!
...I see. Fine!\nWe'll protect everyone!
Yeah!
It stopped moving!?
GYAAAAAAAH!\nAAAAAAH!
GYAAAAAAAH!\nAAAAAAH!
Eep!
Wh-what!?
D-did it... run away?
No idea why! But we're running too!
I always strive to be elegant,\nbut to be honest,\nI was scared out of my wits...
Anyone would feel that way.\nIf anything, it's proof you're a normal human.
A terror on a whole different level from horror movies or mysteries -\nlike having your life scraped out from the roots...\nis that how I'd put it...?
Not a living thing, not a machine -\nsomething more dangerous, something untouchable...\nThat's what it felt like.
Even I could feel\nit wasn't human.
The fact that Mie took that thing's attack head-on\nand didn't die instantly -\nshe's seriously strong.
Nothing but trouble, all of 'em.\nThe weird duo, the black-clad folks...
Houki, any idea where she went?
No, lost her.\nNo readings within sensor range.
Why did she run off halfway?
[MERU]...\nI couldn't do anything for her...
[NOEL]...\nI couldn't do anything for her...
Nothing for you to regret.\nAnd nothing's over yet.
Right. The team headed to Eve's lab\nwill surely find a way to save her.\nLet's believe.
I think it'll be okay!
Sonico...?
Um... I can't really put it into words, but...\nif this world is a story...
you're all super heroines!\nSo if it's you... I just somehow\nbelieve it'll definitely be okay.
Hm...
And...\n[MERU]'s fighting too,\nright now, I'm sure!
She's hanging in there, refusing to lose!
And...\n[NOEL]'s fighting too,\nright now, I'm sure!
She's hanging in there, refusing to lose!
[MERU]'s fighting too...?\nYeah! Yeah, that's right!
[NOEL]'s fighting too...?\nYeah! Yeah, that's right!
In that state, she still has reason...?
After trying so hard\nall this time,\n[MERU]...
No way she'd give up!
After trying so hard\nall this time,\n[NOEL]...
No way she'd give up!
Sonico's right!\nWe'll all try our best! If that fails,\nwe try even harder! That's all there is!
Yes. If we don't stay strong,\nwe won't manage even what we could.
Overthinking everything\nand going negative -\nthat's the most dangerous thing.
I seee - wait,\nisn't it about mealtime?
Honestly, I know nothing more accurate\nthan Koto's stomach clock...
Well, with neither Siesta nor Rin here,\nI shall offer my home cooking...
Whaaat!?
Alright, Cecilia's cooking this time.
Wait, why would you suggest something so terrifying?
If we survive one round of Cecilia's cooking here,\nit'll strengthen our will to live until\nwe get a decent meal!
And what is THAT supposed to mean!?
Hahaha!!
Hah! Yah!
...I can't settle down.
I understand.
I can't settle either, unless I'm listening to the wind.
Yeah...
Nacchan...
Oh my, jealous?\nQuite the siscon, huh?
Wh-what's that supposed to mean. I was just\nchecking whether Nacchan\nwas feeling anxious...
Well, whatever.\nAren't you anxious too, Tesla?
...I'd be lying if I said I wasn't anxious.\nI'm the type who always thinks\nof the worst-case scenario.
Yeah. Maybe that's just how big sisters are.
You've got Shion, don't you, Mion?\nHow can you stay so calm\nin this situationn.
I'm used to it.\nAs head of the Sonozaki family, steeling my resolve\nis something I've been trained in.
'Used to it'...
Honestly, I'm scared.\nBut there are positions where\nyou're not allowed to be scared, y'know? That's it.
...I think I get now\nwhy you have so much charisma\nat your agee.
Charisma!?\nNo way - I'm just the club prez!\nI'm nothing that impressive!
Fufu!
//END
